name: edit_file
description: Edit a file using SEARCH/REPLACE blocks.

body.description:
SEARCH/REPLACE block(s). Format: <<<<<<< SEARCH
old_code
=======
new_code
>>>>>>> REPLACE. Multiple blocks separated by newlines. old_str must match exactly once in the file.

replace_all.description: Allow a SEARCH block to match multiple times and replace every occurrence. Default false (exactly-one match required).

dry_run.description: Validate the edit and report what would change without writing to disk. No backup is made. Default false.

name: create_file
description: Create a new file with given content.

dry_run.description: Report what would be written without touching disk. Default false.

name: insert_file
description: Insert lines at a specific line or after a matched string.

at_line.description: Line number to insert before (1-based). Mutually exclusive with after_str.

after_str.description: Insert immediately after the first line containing this string. Mutually exclusive with at_line.

dry_run.description: Report what would be inserted without touching disk. Default false.

name: list_checkpoints
description: List available checkpoints with SHA, timestamp, message preview, and tool name. Use this to find a rollback target when you need to undo changes.

chat_id.description: Filter by chat ID (omit for current chat)

name: restore_checkpoint
description: Restore workspace files to a previous checkpoint state. Returns a diff summary of what changed. Use after list_checkpoints to pick a SHA.
